name: Sliced Text Image
description: Long scrolling poem page where large headings are sliced into vertical strips that fly in and assemble on scroll, over a tilted grid of dimmed background image tiles.
contents: Paragraph blocks of faint body lines
Sliced display headings in several sizes, fonts, colors and glows
Decorative grid of rotated image tiles behind the text
behavior: Each sliced heading is split into columns that animate into place, scrubbed by scroll, using one of six effects
Background image tiles rotate as they scroll through the viewport
Strip offsets are re-measured on window resize

props.name: blocks
props.default: sample poem with paragraphs and sliced headings

editableByProps: All paragraph and heading text, sizes, fonts, colors, glows and effect choice per block
Background tile images, count, brightness, rotation and radius
Background and text colors, scroll trigger range, smooth scroll toggle

needsCodeEdit.change: Change or add slice animation styles

needsCodeEdit.where: css template literal with the -deco rules

fixed: Takes over page scrolling with Lenis when smoothScroll is true, so it should be the only smooth scroll on the page
Font families are referenced by name only and must be loaded by the host page, otherwise fallback stacks are used
Heading blocks marked full use min-h-screen and spaced headings use 20vh margins to give the scroll effect room
Content stays hidden until images, fonts and libraries are ready
